items.headline: Markets (wk of Sep 7, Fri Sep 11): hot August CPI drove Fed rate-HIKE odds to ~90% for the Sep 16 FOMC; 10-yr Treasury ~4.98% (highest since Oct 2023), 2-yr ~4.65% (2-yr high); S&P -0.8%/Nasdaq -0.7%/Dow -1.6% for the week despite a Friday +1.0% S&P bounce; Brent oil hit a two-month high

Cohere in advanced talks to raise $2-3B at a ~$20B valuation (roughly double its early-2025 mark), with financing reportedly including the Canadian government; a marquee test of the 'sovereign AI' thesis

YC Summer 2026 Demo Day (Sep 10) presented 234 companies to ~1,500 investors; Industrials jumped to ~23% of the batch (2nd-largest after B2B, up from ~13%), with founders clustering around agents that do work, agent-safety infra, and AI wired into the physical world

Four labs shipped new frontier models in one week (Anthropic Claude Fable/Mythos 5.1, OpenAI GPT-6 Astra, Meta Muse Spark 1.3, Google Gemini 3.8 Flash), prompting CNBC 'model fatigue' coverage (Sep 6); Anthropic also rolled out Claude Managed Agents and reportedly committed ~$80B to compute
AI infrastructure led the week's mega-rounds: Crusoe's $3B and Fluidstack's $1.5B took the top two spots in a multibillion-dollar compute/data-center haul
Upwind Security raised $300M co-led by Bessemer Venture Partners and TCV (Salesforce Ventures, Greylock, Craft, Cyberstarts joining) for cloud-runtime security

Pixxel closed a $100M Series C (co-led by Temasek and Seraphim; 360 ONE Asset and IMM Investment joining) - the largest single round ever for an Indian space-tech startup; hyperspectral earth observation for sovereign customers, total raised ~$195M

Humanoids scale in public: the second World Humanoid Robot Games closed in Beijing (2,000+ robots, 666 teams, 51 events), XPeng closed ~$900M for IRON mass production by year-end, and Figure's Index platform passed 16M real-world training videos

Anthropic ships enterprise agent tooling: Claude 'smart reports' (beta) analyzing team usage/costs/friction, and a commerce-agent blueprint with reference shopping/merchant agents, guardrails, and a Claude Code plugin
Matt Wolfe YouTube: 'The Most Useful AI Tools Right Now (2026)' - a tested walkthrough of the working operator's stack (Claude, Cursor, NotebookLM, current agents)

Affinity '10 AI Tools Transforming Venture Capital in 2026' - map of AI across the VC workflow (sourcing, diligence, portfolio monitoring, LP reporting); ~85% of private-capital dealmakers now use AI daily

Markets (wk of Aug 31, Fri Sep 4): hot August jobs report (+162K vs ~53K expected, unemployment 4.1%) killed the September rate-cut case a week after Fed Chair Warsh called inflation 'too high'; S&P 500 ~7,719 (-0.4%), Nasdaq ~26,507 (-0.3%), 10-yr Treasury ~4.78%, 30-yr ~5.25% into the ~Sep 16 FOMC

Andreessen Horowitz raises a $1.1B 'Machine Age' fund (Aug 28) for the physical buildout of AI (chips, data centers, cooling, robots, power) and days later (Aug 31) pushes Growth Fund V to $8.5B, up $1.75B since January; growth practice now $24B+ across five vintages

OpenAI begins staged rollout of GPT-6 'Astra' (Sep 3), billed as its most intelligent/aligned model with SOTA on computer use, software engineering, cybersecurity and science; priced $10/$50 per 1M tokens, trusted orgs first then Plus/Pro/Business/Enterprise

Tesla launches production Cybercab robotaxi (two-seat, no wheel/pedals, nine cameras, AI4) at an invite-only Sep 3 event; limited public paid rides begin in Austin, ~45 Cybercabs in the registered Texas fleet
Crusoe raises $3B+ at a ~$30B valuation (Sep 3), nearly tripling its Oct 2025 mark in a Series F co-led by Atreides and Valor; recently signed a reported $13B GPU-supply deal with Jane Street

Wonderful raises a $550M Series C at $5B (Sep 2), led by Insight Partners (Salesforce Ventures, Index, IVP, Bessemer) - more than doubling its $2B Series B from ~6 months earlier; headcount ~650 across 35+ markets

Global venture funding jumped 122% YoY in August 2026 to $42B across ~1,500 startups (Crunchbase; down 25% from July's $56B); seven billion-dollar rounds led by Databricks' $5B at a $190B valuation, and 5 of 7 mega-recipients had last raised under 12 months prior
Unitree shed nearly half its market value in the days after its ~$66B Aug 19 IPO peak - the first clean public-market repricing of physical-AI/humanoid froth
Ford issues three recalls in one week (headlined by 148,663 Mustangs, wiring harness) and reports August U.S. sales down 10.3% YoY; stock pinned in the mid-$14s
Ethan Mollick publishes 'An opinionated guide to which AI to use to do stuff (Summer 2026 Edition)' - a practical model-by-model tool-selection reference
Ruben Hassid LinkedIn post (Sep 1) on a core Claude cost mechanic - the model re-reads the entire conversation on every prompt, so long threads burn usage fast

Generative AI as 'seniority-biased technological change': Stanford HAI data shows employment for software developers aged 22-25 down ~20% since late 2022 while older devs at the same firms grew 6-12%, eroding the junior-to-senior expertise pipeline

Verticalized-AI seed pattern this week: Metal ($4.5M seed, a16z Speedrun + YC - AI fundraising software), Axle AI ($17.5M Series A, Base10/Gradient/YC - insurtech), Zeit AI (EUR5M seed, YC + Oxford) - capital to AI-in-a-workflow small teams, not horizontal tools

Carta-sourced down-round data circulating this week: ~20% of 2025 rounds were down rounds (double the historical norm), bridge/extension rounds ~16.6% of cash raised, and median gap between primary rounds stretched to ~23 months

Markets (wk of Aug 31): August closed as first up-month since May (S&P +2.6%, Nasdaq +3.9%); early September gave back ground with S&P ~7,650 and Nasdaq ~26,100 as renewed U.S.-Iran hostilities pushed the 10-year Treasury to 4.81%, highest since Nov 2023, and the 30-year above 5.2%

Nvidia closes in on acquisition of Hugging Face for a reported $12.9-14B (Bloomberg, Sep 2: deal could sign this week, ~$1B employee retention package); Hugging Face was valued $4.5B in 2023 and turned down a $500M Nvidia investment at $7B late last year

Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 (Sep 1): 1M-token context, 128K output, 52.6% on Terminal-Bench-Science, and a 75% cache-read price cut making typical workloads ~25% cheaper and highly agentic work up to 45% cheaper
Felix raises $200M (Sep 1) structured as $87M equity led by Andreessen Horowitz plus a $113M General Catalyst credit facility - an emblem of the year's equity-plus-debt growth-round pattern

Waymo launches driverless commercial rides in San Diego, Tampa and Denver (first Colorado market) while Zoox begins supervised testing in Houston and San Diego (Sep 1); Waymo now past 4,000 vehicles across 14 U.S. cities ahead of Tesla's Sep 3 Cybercab event
Funds over $1B have taken ~72% of all venture capital raised in 2026 to date (PitchBook midyear), while H1 2026 minted 195 new unicorns - more than all of 2025's 193

Seed has become a Series A: a16z led 46% of its 48 H1 2026 seed deals at an average $10.5M check; AI seed median pre-money ~$17.9M (42% above non-AI); 90th-percentile seed valuation $93.7M in Q1 (2x 2022); seed deal count -31% YoY while seed dollars +30%

McKinsey State of AI 2026: 32% of organizations have skipped buying at least one software product or feature because agentic coding tools let them build it internally; large enterprises scaling agents in one or more functions rose from 27% to 40%

AI-native startups' effective seed runway is 12-15 months on a $2M raise (vs ~18 for traditional SaaS) because inference/API/fine-tuning costs scale with usage, even as investors now expect 18-24 months post-raise and grade on burn multiple under 2x

Markets (wk of Aug 24-28): S&P 500 +~0.5%, Nasdaq +~0.8% for the week but fell Friday after new Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's first Jackson Hole keynote called inflation 'too high'; September rate-HIKE odds spiked to ~57%, 10-yr Treasury yield rose to ~4.72%, 30-yr ~5.21%; S&P closed ~7,711

AI captured ~$407B of VC in H1 2026 (more than all of 2025) even as deal count collapsed from ~8,290 (2025) to ~3,500 (H1); OpenAI + Anthropic alone took ~$217B (~43% of all Q2 venture dollars); capital concentrating into fewer, larger checks in AI infra/defense/robotics
items.source: Crunchbase News / Second Talent / The Business Perspective

items.headline: Salesforce and Anthropic announce 'Claudeforce' — expanded strategic partnership embedding Claude into Salesforce CRM; 'Salesforce in Claude' in pilot now, open beta expected September 2026
Anthropic unveils the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a software standard letting Claude and similar AI assistants interoperate with robots, scientific instruments, and manufacturing hardware
Valar Atomics raises ~$1B to build modular nuclear reactors to power AI data centers, underscoring the shift of the AI-compute bottleneck toward energy
Anthropic opens ~10,000 free/discounted Claude subscription seats for scientists and adds a free 'Claude for Teachers' enterprise tier for K-12 schools/districts
Tesla says its unsupervised robotaxi fleet is now 'a lot bigger' (Aug 26); registered Texas autonomous fleet reportedly ~37% the size of Waymo's, ahead of the Sept 3 Cybercab launch event
Vuelta a España 2026 underway (Aug 22-Sep 13); Pogačar racing his first Vuelta since 2019; prototype Dura-Ace groupset and custom Pogačar bike on display

Enterprise-agent reality check: Gartner projects ~40% of enterprise apps embed task-specific AI agents by end-2026 (up from <5% in 2025), but McKinsey finds only ~23% of orgs scaling an agentic system while 39% still experimenting
Multi-agent Claude Code workflows tutorial (Skills, Subagents & Handoffs) surfaced as buildable Applied-AI learning content
'AI, Human Cognition and Knowledge Collapse' (Acemoglu & Kong, MIT) argues over-reliance on AI can narrow the diversity of human knowledge; pairs with MIT Sloan 'augmentation trap' framing
